data.name: SetupTagline
data.value: Fixes words typed in the wrong layout.

data.name: LanguageHint
data.value: Choose the language for setup and for the app.

data.name: WelcomeBackHint
data.value: Navpaky found settings from an earlier install.

data.name: KeepHint
data.value: Everything stays as you left it:

data.name: KeptNoDetails
data.value: The settings file can't be read. It is kept as it is.

data.name: StartFreshHint
data.value: Deletes all kept data, as on a first install. The Welcome opens after setup.

data.name: FreshConfirmText
data.value: Navpaky deletes everything left from the earlier install:

data.name: FreshConfirmItems
data.value: • Settings • Learned and protected words • App list • Statistics • Logs

data.name: FreshConfirmWarn
data.value: This can’t be undone. Data is deleted only after the install succeeds.

data.name: FolderHint
data.value: Navpaky installs for your account only.

data.name: FolderQuiet
data.value: No administrator rights needed. Updates install quietly in the background.

data.name: FolderRule
data.value: Navpaky always installs into its own Navpaky folder inside the one you choose.

data.name: FolderSpace
data.value: Needs about {0}. Free on this drive: {1}.

data.name: FolderLocked
data.value: Navpaky is already installed here. To move it, uninstall it first.

data.name: FolderNotEmpty
data.value: This folder isn't empty. Pick an empty or a new folder.

data.name: FolderExtras
data.value: This folder also holds files and folders that aren't part of Navpaky. Reinstalling deletes them:

data.name: FolderOverlapsData
data.value: This is Navpaky's data folder. Pick another folder.

data.name: FolderNotWritable
data.value: This folder needs administrator rights. Pick a folder in your profile.

data.name: FolderNotEnoughSpace
data.value: There isn't enough free space on this drive.

data.name: FolderAllUsers
data.value: Needs administrator rights. When the install starts, Windows asks for an administrator's approval; if your account isn't an administrator, an administrator types their password. Every update asks for this approval again. The prompt closes by itself after about 2 minutes, and the password field uses the keyboard layout that is on. Navpaky goes into Program Files for every account on this PC, and each user keeps their own settings.

data.name: FolderModeMine
data.value: Navpaky is already installed for your account, so it can only be reinstalled for you.

data.name: FolderModeAll
data.value: Navpaky is installed for all users of this PC, so it can only be reinstalled for all users.

data.name: OptionSignInAllUsers
data.value: For all users: it turns on at each user's first sign-in, and each user can turn it off.

data.name: OptionsHint
data.value: You can change these later in Settings.

data.name: OptionSignIn
data.value: Start Navpaky when I sign in to Windows

data.name: OptionShortcutHint
data.value: Navpaky is always in the Start menu and the tray.

data.name: InstallFailed
data.value: The install failed. Everything is as it was before.

data.name: InstallMayStillRun
data.value: The setup did not stop and may still be running. Close the wizard and try again later.

data.name: DoneText
data.value: Find it in the tray and in the Start menu.

data.name: DoneKeep
data.value: Your previous settings are back. The Welcome won’t show again.

data.name: DoneNew
data.value: The Welcome opens and shows how Navpaky works.
